scope: LibreOffice original-file rendering; application behavior probe, not Word or default style acceptance
generator_source:
from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.shared import Pt
import pymupdf
from aspose.words_foss.libreoffice import convert_to_pdf
folder=Path('/tmp/docweave-default-style-probe')
folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for kind in ('character','table'):
    source=Document()
    source.styles['Normal'].font.size=None
    for style in source.styles:
        if style.type == (WD_STYLE_TYPE.CHARACTER if kind=='character' else WD_STYLE_TYPE.TABLE):
            style.element.attrib.pop('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}default',None)
    style=source.styles.add_style('Marked Default', WD_STYLE_TYPE.CHARACTER if kind=='character' else WD_STYLE_TYPE.TABLE)
    style.element.set('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}default','1')
    style.font.size=Pt(30)
    if kind=='character':
        source.add_paragraph('IMPLICIT')
        source.add_paragraph().add_run('EXPLICIT').style=style
    else:
        source.add_table(1,1).cell(0,0).text='IMPLICIT'
        table=source.add_table(1,1)
        table.style=style
        table.cell(0,0).text='EXPLICIT'
    control=source.styles.add_style('Explicit Control', WD_STYLE_TYPE.CHARACTER)
    control.font.size=Pt(23)
    source.add_paragraph().add_run('STYLE CONTROL').style=control
    source.add_paragraph().add_run('DIRECT CONTROL').font.size=Pt(24)
    path=folder/f'{kind}.docx'
    source.save(path)
    convert_to_pdf(path,path.with_suffix('.pdf'))
    with pymupdf.open(path.with_suffix('.pdf')) as pdf:
        spans=[(s['text'],s['size']) for page in pdf for block in page.get_text('dict')['blocks'] for line in block.get('lines',[]) for s in line['spans']]
    print(kind,spans,flush=True)
